fields.title: 📖 Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn: The Dunyā Is Nothing When You Are Free for Allah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn** said to Ibn al-Junayd, when he had neither child nor wife:

> ***“What then holds you here? Go to the Thaghr or cast yourself upon those coasts, for the Dunyā is nothing.”***

What is meant is not aimless danger, but an education of the heart: whoever has fewer ties should not lose his free time in idleness.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever has been made free for **Allah** should not give that freedom away to the Dunyā. True strength is to fill the short lifetime with benefit, Taqwā, and serious effort.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Junayd, Suʾālāt Ibn al-Junayd li-Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn, Nr. 301, S. 346.
